evidence.section: SOK to Splunk Enterprise version compatibility and upgrade guidance
evidence.statement: SOK 3.2 Help lists Kubernetes 1.32–1.37 and Enterprise 10.0.12–10.6.0, with Operator-first sequencing. The September 8 project changelog lists Kubernetes 1.32–1.36 and Enterprise 10.6.0. The Queue secretKeyRef change is confined to Index & Ingestion Separation. No 11.x combination is established.
